newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rostelekom sees rise in IAS net.
newsitem.headline: Rostelekom sees rise in IAS net.

text.p: Russian long-distance telephone operator Rostelekom expects on the basis of preliminary estimates that its 1996 net profit according to international accounting standards was $265 million, a senior company official said.

In 1995 AOOT Mezhdugorodnoi i Mezhdunarodnoi Elektricheskoi Svyazi Rostelekom had a net profit according to international accounting standards of 1.15 trillion roubles, calculated at the January 1, 1996 exchange rate of 4,640 roubles per dollar. This works out at $247 million.
Sales in 1996 were around $2.0 billion after $1.78 billion (8.27 trillion roubles) in 1995, securities department director Igor Kocheshkov told Reuters.
He said 1996 accounts were being prepared by international auditors Coopers & Lybrand. The preliminary estimates for 1996 were produced by Rostelekom's own analysts.
